name: OMB Memoranda
known_limitations: The index establishes that an OMB memorandum was issued and provides the controlling document. Each claim still requires the dated memorandum, its scope, deadlines, exceptions, and any later amendment or rescission.

automation_notes: Track new memoranda affecting AI, cybersecurity, procurement, data, infrastructure, grants, and reporting. Verify each memorandum directly before changing a signal.
